name: Celestial Astrolabe Sanctuary
core_rationale: Central starlight-armillary sanctuary town of Celestial Astrolabe Atoll at [1, 1] where star-navigators calibrate the outer meridian rings above the Starlight Orrery Nave.

terrain_tile.water_feature: Luminous silver star-tide basins reflecting the rotating brass armillary spheres overhead

North.lock_message: Shearing orbital starlight across Equinox-Zenith Arch buffets unanchored gliders; Astrolabe-Keeper Caelum requires the Celestial Vernier Key before unlocking the northern equinox gate.

resident_npcs.name: Astrolabe-Keeper Caelum
resident_npcs.dialogue_greeting: Welcome to Celestial Astrolabe Sanctuary! Step up to my 0.58 meter brass star-globe—every ring of the Shattered Halo is charted from this plaza.

resident_npcs.name: Vernier-Wright Selene
resident_npcs.dialogue_greeting: Beneath our sanctuary in the Starlight Orrery Nave, an orbital astrolabe colossus holds the Celestial Vernier Key needed for Equinox-Zenith Arch!

causal_continuity.evidence: Anchors Celestial Astrolabe Atoll at [1, 1] directly above Vesper's Starlight Orrery Nave and connects west to Armillary Ring Causeway.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: Floating basalt-and-brass sanctuary encircled by nested starlight armillary spheres.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: 0.58 to 0.60m star-globe tables, 0.14m basalt risers, 2.20m x 1.65m doorways, and 13.0m plazas for 1.05m characters.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: Safe town hub (0 resident_spawns) at [1, 1] with symmetric West, Dungeon, and North (fog_of_lore) portals.

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: Guards the northern Equinox-Zenith Arch behind a Fog of Lore portal with explicit lock_message.
